findings.narrative: Between February and April 2026 the company paid five invoices from a vendor that the tax authority lists as issuing invoices for non-existent operations. No purchase order, contract, or delivery record supports any of the five invoices, all of which were paid in full.

exhibits.note: CFDI invoice INV-00701 issued by the vendor with no delivery evidence.
CFDI invoice INV-00702 issued by the vendor with no delivery evidence.
CFDI invoice INV-00703 issued by the vendor with no delivery evidence.
CFDI invoice INV-00704 issued by the vendor with no delivery evidence.
CFDI invoice INV-00705 issued by the vendor with no delivery evidence.
Vendor listed as definitive EFOS under CFF Article 69-B.

adversarial_review.challenger_argument: The invoices could cover legitimate services delivered informally.
adversarial_review.why_finding_held: The vendor is a definitive EFOS and no contract, purchase order, or delivery evidence exists for any invoice.

findings.rule_broken: LFPIORPI Articulo 17 (estratificacion circular y retorno de fondos)
findings.narrative: In May 2026 the company sent money through three intermediaries that returned almost all of it to the company within five days. Each hop kept a 2% margin and none of the intermediaries delivered goods or services.

exhibits.note: SPEI transfer BNK-00901 inside the closed circuit.
SPEI transfer BNK-00902 inside the closed circuit.
SPEI transfer BNK-00903 inside the closed circuit.
SPEI transfer BNK-00904 inside the closed circuit.

adversarial_review.challenger_argument: The transfers could be ordinary supplier financing.
adversarial_review.why_finding_held: Funds returned to the origin within five days with no commercial documents at any hop.

findings.narrative: After a June 2026 maintenance invoice was paid, the vendor transferred 30% of it to an employee, who forwarded part of that money to a third company two days later.

leads_not_pursued.signal: Vendor invoice volume rose 400% quarter over quarter (invoice velocity detector).
leads_not_pursued.reason: Contract CTR-00007 signed 2025-11-02 covers the expanded scope; all 12 invoices match approved purchase orders within limits and each was settled by SPEI to the vendor's registered CLABE.

leads_not_pursued.signal: Employee bank CLABE shares the bank prefix of vendor DDDD040404DD4 (employee-vendor CLABE linkage detector).
leads_not_pursued.reason: Only the 3-digit bank institution prefix (012) matches; the full 18-digit CLABEs differ and no bank_txns record moves funds between the two accounts in the audit period.

leads_not_pursued.signal: Two invoices of $49,900.00 within 3 days, just under the $50,000.00 approval limit (threshold splitting detector).
leads_not_pursued.reason: Invoice INV-00341 was cancelled (status cancelado) and reissued as INV-00342 with a corrected concepto; a single payment BNK-00410 of $49,900.00 settled it.

leads_not_pursued.signal: Vendor registered 20 days before its first invoice (new vendor detector).
leads_not_pursued.reason: Purchase order PO-00288 and contract CTR-00031 predate the first invoice, and the delivery acceptance in ledger entry 5521 was approved by the plant controller.

method_and_limits.architecture_summary: Deterministic detectors scan the estate for known risk signals. An investigator agent examines each lead with read-only database tools, a challenger agent argues the defense, and a deterministic validator rejects any finding whose cited records do not exist or whose amount does not reconcile within 2%.
out_of_scope: Payroll records beyond the employees table.
CFDI XML signatures; only invoice table fields were examined.
Transactions outside the audit period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30.
undetectable_fraud_types: Cash bribes paid outside the banking system.
Collusion documented only in email, messaging, or verbal agreements.
Kickbacks routed through accounts not registered in vendors or employees.
reproducibility_steps: Generate the estate with seed 7 using the project seeder.
Run the auditor against the estate path with network access disabled.
Validate the output: python validate_format.py --submission submission.json --estate estate.db
Open the exported case file; the same seed yields an identical file.
